decisions.decision: Use the supplied ChatInput composition with existing wallet-kit primitives; keep local interpretation and explicit review before publication.
Remove the Overview hero and goal panel, shorten the footer, and place colorful real-wallet asset cards below funding.
Display palka. in both public and desktop branding without changing internal identifiers.

Replace the separate gradient asset cards with one compact charcoal list: colored round icons, stacked labels, right-aligned exact balances, and inset dividers. No fiat quotes without a real price source.

Move funding to a shared Top up navbar tab. Use a compact balance card, a Receive BTC disclosure, one amount field, and explicit transfer review. Keep funding mounted across navigation to preserve pending approval state.
decisions.source: User request and public 21st Wallet Card 2 preview, 2026-10-17
decisions.implementation: Adapted with existing wallet-kit primitives; registry CLI requires sign-in.

decisions.decision: Show the order book and exact wallet balances in aligned Overview columns, stacking on mobile. Remove the wallet Market tab. Use a short accent on the first a in pálka. navbars and pálka without a dot in footers.
Cycle English swap examples with a type-and-erase placeholder. Keep user input untouched, stop while it is nonempty, and show static text for reduced motion.

Use restrained dark liquid-glass surfaces and softly colored glass asset icons. Reuse exact wallet names, units and balances in both Overview and keyboard-accessible Give/Receive selectors. Preserve atomic-unit inputs and local policy checks.
decisions.implementation: Adapted existing wallet-kit primitives; 21st catalog search requires sign-in.

decisions.decision: Adapt Apple iPhone patterns in the shared wallet UI: grouped asset rows, rounded glass menus, native checked-state switches, a mobile review sheet, and system typography for wallet assets and review. Use subtle monochrome Matrix rain across wallet and public pages; respect reduced motion and transparency.
decisions.implementation: React and CSS adaptation using existing components; no native UIKit dependency or bundled Apple fonts.
